$comment: Resident pairs (vertical slice design §3-5·§9-1, W5). key joins the two residents in resident order. topic is the small difference the two work out together — it only ever moves up a step (0~2), one step each time one of frictionCards is solved by the two of them. scene is the pair's own scene (PAIR01~03); a card's pair path and a chat between the two are both that pair's scenes. chatSpots: where two residents talk in each place (a place with no entry has no chat).
